integrity: The infinite-field claims follow from the written polynomial proof; the standalone exact symbolic and F4 checks supplement that proof. Neither independent audit nor external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The reduced dual singular set and ambient local multiplicities are proved, not the nonreduced Jacobian scheme, resolution, normalization or conductor; the conclusion applies only in characteristic two with nonzero diagonal quadric coefficients. Literature priority remains subject to specialist historical checking.
title: Degree-twelve duals of characteristic-two quartics with a tetrahedral singular locus
